# Flagship run - nimbus-train on TinyStories

- model: 4,854,272 params, GPT-2 style (4 layers, d_model 256, d_mlp 768, vocab 8,192 BPE)
- data: TinyStoriesV2-GPT4, 100 MB slice -> 25.2M train tokens (+296k val)
- schedule: 6,000 steps x batch 32 x seq 256 = 49.2M tokens (~10 tok/param)
- hardware: i7-12700H laptop, CPU only, pure NumPy, ~6.4 h wall clock
- throughput: ~2,330 tokens/s sustained; final loss 1.825 (val 1.838, ppl ~6.3)

## LoRA SFT demo (300 steps, r=8, 65,536 trainable params = 1.3%)

Task: first sentence -> story completion, loss on completion tokens only.
Completion loss 2.12 -> 1.73 over 300 steps (~7 min on CPU).

## DPO demo (150 steps, r=8, beta=0.1, synthetic swapped-continuation pairs)

Preference accuracy 50% (random, policy == frozen reference at init) -> **90-100%**;
DPO loss 0.693 (ln 2, the theoretical starting point) -> ~0.15.
